row: Lady Bits Physical therapy, owned by physical therapist Julie Kwong, MPT is a place for women to come and learn about their pelvic floor muscles and so much more. This channel will assist in understanding of  how to use your pelvic floor and other synergistic core muscles to maintain and restore normal healthy function throughout our lives. Prenatal preparation and postnatal recovery, as well as exercises safe for prolapse, diastasis recti, and generalized weakness resulting in incontinence and more will be presented as program is developed.
